title: 300 ming dollarga yaqin taklifni rad etgan aktyor kim?
hook: Pulsiz aktyor katta taklifni rad etdi.

scenes.text: 1975 yilda puli deyarli yo'q, kam taniqli aktyor boksyor haqida ssenariy yozdi.
scenes.keywords: man typing on old typewriter at night

scenes.text: Studiya uni sotib olmoqchi bo'ldi. Aytilishicha, taklif taxminan 300 ming dollarga yetgan.
U bitta shart qo'ydi: bosh rolni o'zi o'ynaydi. Bu Silvestr Stallone edi.
U ancha kam pulga rozi bo'ldi, Rokki esa eng yaxshi film uchun Oskar oldi.
scenes.keywords: golden award statue on stage spotlight
boxer raising arms in empty ring

description:
1975 yilda Silvestr Stallone Rokki ssenariysini yozdi va studiyaning katta taklifini rad etib, bosh rolni o'zi o'ynash shartini qo'ydi. Taklif summasi manbalarda har xil (taxminan 265 mingdan 360 minggacha). 1976 yilda chiqqan Rokki eng yaxshi film uchun Oskar mukofotini oldi.

Bu saboq sizga kerakmi? Izohda bitta so'z bilan yozing.
source: Fact-check 2026-11-12 (web search). Stallone refused to sell the Rocky script unless he played the lead (Britannica). The reported top offer varies by source: about $265,000-275,000 (AFI trade item, 1976 NYT recollection), $325,000 (ThinkAdvisor), $360,000 (Good Morning America), up to $375,000 (other). So the exact '325 ming' was removed from title and script: title now says '300 ming dollarga yaqin', scene 2 says 'aytilishicha ... taxminan 300 ming'. He accepted far less, commonly reported as about $35,000. Rocky won Best Picture at the 1977 Academy Awards (for 1976 films). Sources: https://www.britannica.com/topic/Rocky-film-by-Avildsen ; https://catalog.afi.com/Catalog/moviedetails/53862 ; https://www.goodmorningamerica.com/news/story/sylvester-stallone-struggling-actor-wrote-starred-rocky-37005982 ; https://www.thinkadvisor.com/amp/2010/11/30/dont-stop-chasing-your-dream/
